news.headline: Seven things Solak thinks for NFL Week 9: Bucs atop NFC South? RB trades coming?
news.description: Get ready for Week 9 with takes on the Bucs' division chances, why RBs could dominate the trade deadline and which teams should at least ask about Justin Herbert.

news.headline: Fantasy buzz: No stopping Bears, Seahawks ease Charbonnet back, Minshew impact
news.description: The Bears' offense is full of must-start players, Seahawks backfield still in flux as Charbonnet, Price return

news.headline: Trio brought in to replace All-Pro DE has shined for Bengals
news.description: Hendrickson has two sacks in Baltimore; Lawrence, Allen and Mafe have produced 13.5 in Cincinnati.

news.headline: Jeffery Simmons stymies QB Sam Darnold, Seahawks in Bears debut
news.description: New Bears DT Jeffery Simmons had a sack, six tackles and deflected a pass as Chicago won its third straight Monday, and he also earned a game ball.

news.headline: Why Colts are right to consider trading Jonathan Taylor
news.description: As the Colts begin their rebuild, they need draft picks, and Taylor is their most valuable asset.

news.headline: Five things Saints must fix entering Week 9 vs. Browns
news.description: Protecting QB Tyler Shough, getting the run game going and igniting slow starts are among areas coach Kellen Moore is fixated on repairing.

news.headline: Jeffery Simmons, Bears' defense handle Seahawks
news.description: Caleb Williams and Jeffery Simmons had the Bears controlling both sides of the ball on MNF.

news.headline: Packers sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite latest abuse allegations
news.description: Packers coach Matt LaFleur says the team is sticking with RB Josh Jacobs despite new allegations of abuse levied by multiple women in addition to a May incident that led to his arrest.

news.headline: Myles Garrett will return to practice this week for Los Angeles Rams
news.description: Los Angeles Rams star pass rusher Myles Garrett, who has been on injured reserve since having arthroscopic knee surgery in mid-September, will return to practice this week, coach Sean McVay told reporters Monday.

news.headline: Cardinals name Gardner Minshew as starter, move Jacoby Brissett to QB3
news.description: The Cardinals named Gardner Minshew as the team's new starting QB while moving Jacoby Brissett below rookie Carson Beck on the depth chart.

news.headline: Cardinals' Mike LaFleur: Jeremiyah Love's injury to 'new portion' of his ankle
news.description: Cardinals rookie running back Jeremiyah Love suffered a new ankle injury in Sunday's win over the Cowboys, coach Mike LaFleur said.

news.headline: Vikings uncertain of QB Kyler Murray's status vs. Bills due to sore hamstring
news.description: Vikings QB Kyler Murray's status for the Week 9 game against the Bills is uncertain due to a sore hamstring.

news.headline: Dolphins' blown lead another lesson in a season full of them
news.description: The Dolphins are hoping to learn another lesson from the Patiots: It takes from kickoff until the final whistle.

news.headline: Shane Steichen sticking with Daniel Jones as Colts' QB1 for Week 9 vs. Cowboys
news.description: Daniel Jones will remain the Colts' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

news.headline: Brandon Aiyuk hires Drew Rosenhaus as agent, eyes return to NFL
news.description: Brandon Aiyuk has hired agent Drew Rosenhaus, who told ESPN's Adam Schefter that he is "working on getting him back to work and playing again in the NFL."

news.headline: Record-setting deal? Trade? A look at Lamar Jackson's cloudy future with Ravens
news.description: It's possible that Jackson's final snap with the Ravens ended with injury Sunday night.

plan: Push every chip in: future picks are worth more to you as points now.
Buy proven vets that rebuilders are dumping at a discount.
Plan the exit: sell the oldest starters the offseason after the title run, before their value drops.
reasons: 3rd of 14 in points a week the rest of the way (299.1)
19% of player value is 24 or younger (11th most)

build.name: Dynasty Juggernaut
build.about: Strong now and strong later: top-third points and top-third dynasty value without an old core.
plan: Win now without spending the future: trade depth and later picks for upgrades, not young starters.
Sell any starter about to age out a year early while he still has value.
Keep one or two firsts a year so the window never closes.

build.name: Full Teardown
build.about: Bottom of the league with an older roster and little youth, so the fastest path is to sell everything.
plan: Sell every vet now for picks; each loss improves your own pick.
Aim the tank at the 1.01 and stack firsts in the next two drafts.
Take young upside fliers as throw-ins in every deal.

build.name: Playoff Bubble
build.about: Middle of the pack on points but in or near a playoff spot.
plan: Fix the one or two weakest starting spots; a small upgrade swings a bubble team.
Pay with depth and seconds, not firsts, unless the upgrade makes you a top-three team.
If the record slips below the line by midseason, flip to a retool and sell the vets.
